desc: Iterate through every cell in the grid; if a cell contains '1', treat it as the start of a potential V-shaped segment.
For each starting cell, simulate the path in all four initial diagonal directions (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) while verifying the sequence matches 1, 2, 0, 2, 0...
During simulation, detect if a clockwise 90-degree turn to a different diagonal direction is possible while maintaining the sequence; if so, continue the path in the new direction.
Track the maximum length of any valid segment found across all starting positions and directions.
Return the maximum length found, or 0 if no valid segment exists.
Write the final Python code implementing the DFS with memoization as analyzed.
Verify the logic handles the "at most one clockwise turn" constraint correctly.
Run the solution against the provided examples to verify correctness.
Check edge cases: single cell grid, no '1's, grid with only '1's, grid with only '2's and '0's.
Update the code to initialize `max_len` to 1 if the grid contains at least one '1', otherwise 0. This fixes the edge case where a single '1' exists but has no neighbors.
